body_markdown:
*Industry leaders from Array, Spiral, and Unifimoney will join Alkami to explore how financial institutions can make[financial wellness](https://www.alkami.com/digital-banking-solutions/retail-banking/financial-wellness/) drive engagement and primacy*


**September 16, 2026 (Plano, Texas)** – Alkami Technology, Inc. (Nasdaq: ALKT) (“Alkami”), a[digital sales and service platform provider](https://www.alkami.com/) for financial institutions in the U.S., today announced it will host a webinar exploring how financial wellness can help[banks](https://www.alkami.com/banks/) and[credit unions](https://www.alkami.com/credit-unions/) strengthen relationships, increase engagement and retention, and drive long-term growth. The webinar, “[More Than a Feature: Financial Wellness as a Growth Strategy](https://my.demio.com/ref/W1IZxqsCYlEs384D) ,” will take place on Thursday, October 1, 2026, at 1:00 p.m. EDT.


The discussion will feature:


- [Warren Dunton](https://www.linkedin.com/in/warrendunton/) , senior channel manager at[Array](https://www.alkami.com/partner/integration/array/)
- [Shawn Melamed](https://www.linkedin.com/in/shawn-jacob-melamed/) , chief executive officer and founder of[Spiral](https://www.alkami.com/integration/spiral/)
- [Liz Seither](https://www.linkedin.com/in/lizsseither/) , head of client success at[Unifimoney](https://www.alkami.com/integration/unifimoney/)
- [Chuck Hayes](https://www.linkedin.com/in/cfhayesjr/) , executive vice president of growth at[Unifimoney](https://www.alkami.com/integration/unifimoney/)
- [Molly Irelan](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mollyirelan/) , manager of research and content at[Alkami](https://www.alkami.com/)


Financial wellness is no longer limited to budgeting tools and credit scores. Today’s account holders increasingly expect personalized guidance, meaningful insights, and intuitive digital experiences that help them make confident financial decisions. When those experiences live outside the primary financial relationship, banks and credit unions risk losing engagement and the opportunity to become the financial institution account holders turn to first. With financial well-being declining among young adults and price increases remaining the most common financial concern, financial wellness tools can help banks and credit unions play a more meaningful role in account holders’ financial lives.1


During the webinar, speakers will discuss how financial institutions can bring together complementary solutions that support account holders across their financial journeys from building credit and growing savings to investing for the future. They will also explore how these embedded, actionable experiences can deepen engagement, strengthen loyalty, and create new opportunities for growth.


The discussion will explore:


- Why financial wellness has become a business imperative for banks and credit unions.
- How credit-building, savings, and investing capabilities can support engagement, primacy, and growth.
- The evolving expectations of today’s account holders, including younger generations.
- Practical considerations for evaluating financial wellness solutions that align with a financial institution’s strategic priorities.


“Financial wellness is most powerful when it is treated as an ongoing journey and not a single feature or one-time interaction,” said Chuck Hayes, executive vice president of growth at Unifimoney. “By helping account holders build a strong financial foundation, grow their savings, and invest for the future through the institutions they already trust, banks and credit unions can create more meaningful engagement while strengthening long-term relationships and expanding their role in the financial lives of the people they serve.”


To register for the complimentary webinar, visit[here](https://my.demio.com/ref/W1IZxqsCYlEs384D) .


To learn more about Anticipatory Banking and the Alkami Digital Sales & Service Platform, visit[here](https://www.alkami.com/digital-banking-solutions/) .


**About Alkami**


[Alkami](https://www.alkami.com/press-room/) provides a digital sales and service platform for U.S. banks and credit unions. Our unified Platform integrates onboarding,[digital banking](https://www.alkami.com/resources/client-success/case-study/southland-credit-union-uses-the-digital-banking-platform-to-reimagine-member-experience/) , and data and marketing—each solution can stand alone, but together they deliver more—to help institutions onboard, engage, and grow relationships. As the future shifts toward Anticipatory Banking, we help data-informed bankers meet the moment with technology that drives action.


1[Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System.](https://www.federalreserve.gov/publications/files/2025-report-economic-well-being-us-households-202605.pdf)[(2026, May).](https://www.federalreserve.gov/publications/files/2025-report-economic-well-being-us-households-202605.pdf)[Economic well-being of U.S. households in 2025](https://www.federalreserve.gov/publications/files/2025-report-economic-well-being-us-households-202605.pdf) .
